label: Rent-to-Buy
agreementCount: {count, plural, one {# agreement} other {# agreements}} total
noAgreementsDesc: Browse rent-to-buy listings to get started.
disclosureFirst: Possession is separate from ownership. You take possession once the merchant hands the item over and you confirm receipt — the merchant remains the owner until the full rent-to-buy amount is paid AND a short completion window has passed after you receive it.
disclosureDefault: If this agreement formally defaults after you have taken possession, the purchase path ends and the item must be returned. Unity charges the merchant's rental/use rate for the time you actually had the item, capped at the funds already held — you are never charged more than what is already held in escrow.
securityDeposit: Security deposit (not part of purchase price)
terminated: Rent-to-buy purchase path terminated — settled as a rental/use period for the time the item was actually possessed.
returnRequiredNotice: Item return required. If it is not returned by the agreed return deadline, the security deposit is forfeited.
evidenceRequiredMerchant: Upload at least one photo/video of the item's condition before marking this agreement handed over.
evidenceRequiredCustomer: Upload at least one photo/video of the item's condition on receipt before confirming possession.
completionWindowNotice: Ownership finalizes automatically once the completion window has passed with no unresolved dispute.
amendmentPending: Awaiting response from the other party
terminationPending: Mutual termination proposed — awaiting the other party's response
initiateDefaultWarning: This is permanent. Once you initiate a formal default, it cannot be reversed or cured.
requestSentDesc: Your request has been sent to the merchant. This does not reserve the item or complete any payment — you will be notified once the merchant responds.
reviewTermsDesc: These are the merchant's terms for this item. Review them carefully before requesting.
disclosurePossession: Possession is separate from ownership — you take possession once the merchant hands the item over and you confirm receipt.
disclosureOwnership: The merchant remains the owner until the full amount is paid, you have received the item, and a short completion window has passed with no dispute.
disclosureEscrow: Instalments are held (escrow-governed) until the agreement completes successfully or is settled after a default — they are not paid to the merchant immediately.
rtbSectionDesc: This item is also available on a rent-to-buy basis — pay in instalments and own it once fully paid.
committedToRentToBuyDesc: This item is currently reserved under an active rent-to-buy agreement.
